message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, how does Alex’s warning about danger differ from Ya na’s warning about problems: in voice, or only wording? Which line deserves your attention most, and what would count as evidence of a distinct speaker? Why would more thought help more than an informative attempt now, and what unresolved uncertainty might make acting premature? Could you briefly name your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next action in English, then carry out that choice?
